description: Capabilities granted to the Anatria3D main window.
//: There is no shell permission here, and no shell plugin in Cargo.toml.
The AI engine is spawned from Rust with std::process::Command, so the
webview has no path to executing anything — not the engine, not an
arbitrary program. See src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs for why.
`dialog:allow-save` and `opener:allow-open-path` exist only so a generated
report can be written to a user-chosen location and then opened.
